questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What does ON DELETE CASCADE do?
questions.correctAnswer: Deletes child rows when the parent is deleted
